entries.title: Proverbs 12:1
segments: Whoever loves instruction loves knowledge; but he who hates correction [is] like a brute [animal].

entries.title: Proverbs 12:2
segments: The good gets grace from the LORD, but He will condemn a man of wicked thoughts.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:3
segments: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:4
segments: A woman of virtue [is] a crown to her husband, but she who causes shame [is] like rottenness in his bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:5
segments: The thoughts of the righteous [are] right; the counsels of the wicked [are] deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:6
segments: The words of the wicked [are] to lie in wait for blood; but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:7
segments: The wicked are overthrown, and [are] gone; but the house of the righteous shall stand.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:8
segments: A man shall be praised according to his wisdom, but he who is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:9
segments: Better is a despised one, and having a servant, than he honoring himself and lacks bread.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:10
segments: A righteous one understands the soul of his animal; but the tender mercies of the wicked [are] cruel.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:11
segments: He who tills his land shall be satisfied [with] bread; but he who follows vanities lacks heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:12
segments: The wicked desires the net of evils; but the root of the righteous yields [fruit].

entries.title: Proverbs 12:13
segments: The wicked [is] snared by the transgression of [his] lips, but the just shall come out of trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:14
segments: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of [his] mouth, and the reward of a man's hands shall be given to him.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:15
segments: The way of a fool [is] right in his own eyes, hut he who listens to advice [is] wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:16
segments: A fool's vexation is known in a day, but the astute one covers shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:17
segments: He who breathes truth shows forth righteousness, but a false witness deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:18
segments: There are those who speak like the thrusts of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:19
segments: The lips of truth shall be established forever, but only while I wink [is] a lying tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:20
segments: Deceit [is] in the heart of those who imagine evil, but to counselors of peace [there is] joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:21
segments: No evil shall happen to the just, but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:22
segments: Lying lips [are] hateful to the LORD, but those who deal truly [are] His delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:23
segments: A wise man conceals knowledge, but the heart of fools cries out foolishness.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:24
segments: The hand of the hard worker shall bear rule, but the lazy shall be under service.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:25
segments: Heaviness in the heart of man makes it stoop, but a good word makes it glad.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:26
segments: The righteous [is] more excellent than his neighbor, but the way of the wicked seduces them.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:27
segments: The lazy one does not start after his game, but the wealth of a hard worker [is] precious.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:28
segments: In the way of righteousness [is] life, and in that pathway [there is] no death.
